project_info.name: SPPU TYBSc CS E-Commerce Deal & Price Aggregator
project_info.syllabus_context: Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) Third Year B.Sc. Computer Science Final Year Project. Designed with syllabus concepts (HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript frontend architecture, Python/SQLite backend concepts, JSON REST APIs, relational search data collection) wrapped in a modern React + Tailwind production UI.
project_info.theme_mode: Light/Dark Dual Support with default Light Theme for clean academic evaluation and crisp product price comparison contrast.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none
scale.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

primary_brand.description: Deep Navy Slate anchor for trust, clarity, and structural authority.

deal_best_accent.description: Vivid Emerald Green reserved exclusively for Best Deal, Lowest Price Badge, and savings highlight.

layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: All bordered cards must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Main layout uses max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.

components_and_structure.navigation_bar: Sticky header with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50), featuring Logo, Live/Demo Mode Switcher, Search Input, Section Tabs (Compare, Data Collected, Academic Docs, Login/User Profile), and Theme Toggle.
components_and_structure.hero_search_section: Asymmetric search banner with prompt suggestions (e.g., 'MacBook Air M2', 'iPhone 15 128GB', 'Wireless Earbuds', 'Gaming Laptop') and toggle between Tech (Mobiles/Laptops) & General Products mode.
components_and_structure.best_deal_banner: High-impact recommendation engine widget highlighting the single best seller option with total savings calculation, seller delivery speed, and confidence score.
components_and_structure.comparison_table: Side-by-side spec and price matrix comparing Amazon, Flipkart, Croma, Reliance Digital, and local merchants with sortable columns, discount percentages, and affiliate demo links.
components_and_structure.collected_data_view: Admin/Syllabus analytics panel displaying stored search logs, query frequency, price variance charts, and SQLite backend schema simulation.
components_and_structure.documentation_viewer: Comprehensive Academic Project Section containing SPPU TYBSc CS Syllabus Mapping, Certificate Template, System Architecture Diagram, ER Model, Data Flow Diagram (DFD Level 0 & 1), SRS Guidelines, and Index.

visual_enhancers.card_style: Flat subtle cards with 1px border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), rounded-xl, hover:border-emerald-500/50 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.deal_highlight: Emerald glow or soft tint (bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-500)
visual_enhancers.live_vs_demo_badge: Interactive status indicator showing whether live API search or SQLite demo dataset is active

motion_and_interactions.framework: framer-motion for tab switches, search reveal, modal overlays, and price drop badges
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth button click scaling (active:scale-95), hover lift on cards (-translate-y-0.5), and pulse animation on Best Deal highlight.

images.description: Modern laptop sitting on top of a table for tech comparison header
MacBook Pro beside iPad and iPhone for mobile and laptop search grid
Shopping basket, paper bag, target and chart icon for price deal analytics
SPPU Computer Science students working on web project for project documentation section

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, search input, filter item, comparison cell, login form, and tab MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure .js files (JavaScript/JSX) are maintained properly without introducing breaking TypeScript mismatch.
Include a prominent 'Academic Documentation' drawer/tab with SPPU TYBSc CS Syllabus guidelines, Index, ER Diagram, Data Flow Diagram (DFD), and Certificate Generator.
Support both Demo SQLite catalog and Live integration mode toggling smoothly.
Highlight the Best Deal with distinct green styling, savings badge, and seller breakdown.
Make sure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
